zh-CN.name: 卡片依次上移淡入
zh-CN.description: 卡片通过位移和透明度变化依次进入画面。
use_when: 首次展示少量内容卡片，需要让用户看清出现顺序
avoid_when: 用户连续刷新列表，重复动画拖慢阅读
zh-CN.prompt_template: 首次加载后，卡片从下方 {offset_y_px}px 上移至原位并淡入，单张持续 {duration_ms}ms，相邻卡片间隔 {delay_ms}ms，使用 {easing} 缓动。减少动态效果时直接显示最终状态。

en.name: Staggered card slide and fade
en.description: Cards enter sequentially through a change in position and opacity.
use_when: Introducing a small set of cards for the first time
avoid_when: Repeated list refreshes where motion would slow reading
en.prompt_template: After the initial load, fade each card in while moving it from {offset_y_px}px below its final position. Use a duration of {duration_ms}ms, a stagger delay of {delay_ms}ms, and {easing} easing. Show the final state immediately when reduced motion is requested.

sources.note: 本维护包原创说明；数值为样例方案，不是行业标准。注册表未连接实际渲染器。
